nodes.title: Image pack build step: Codex masters stay in public/assets/gen/** (where the prompt writes them); scripts/gen-assets.mjs converts each landed master to content-hashed 1x/2x WebP under public/assets/art/** (q 80 first, stepping down to fit the §12 budgets; an image that cannot fit, fails the lamp-hue lint or carries OCR text is NOT shipped and its designed fallback renders) and writes public/assets/gen/manifest.json (urls, CSS size, bytes, LQIP for scenes, lint share, OCR result, MANIFEST.topicMap). The vite plugin taxila:art-masters deletes dist/assets/gen/** except manifest.json, so masters never ship. Encoder: sharp if installed, else ImageMagick (libwebp). Reversal: the Codex prompt writes masters outside public/ (then the plugin goes), or the Docker build gets an encoder and runs gen-assets itself (then public/assets/art need not be committed)

gen-assets over the landed pack (B00-B02, 26 masters, 6.7 MB): 22 shipped + 0 passthrough, every one within budget at the first quality (q 80); 1x 1.6-63 KB (phone backgrounds 10-16 KB of the 60 KB budget, wide 38-63 KB of 120 KB), 2x max 159 KB; 0 lamp-hue failures (max share 1.25 %, bg/stage-young; bar 1.5 %); public/assets/art 2.2 MB; 23 s wall with ImageMagick 6 + libwebp 1.3.2 (n = 1 run). OCR NOT run: no AZURE_VISION_ENDPOINT / AZURE_VISION_KEY in .env.local. 217 ids pending in INDEX.json; bg/who-wide and bg/garden-panorama failed, bg/who-phone skipped (their flat fallbacks render)

The child home is never an empty card (audit #9): the server plan state is shown as-is; when GET /api/child/plan fails (404 / 5xx / wrong shape / 6 s timeout) the home shows `start` with the last topic the plan returned on this device (else "Start a lesson" with no topic) and Start goes to /lesson/new (the server resolves the next planned topic; a failure there is the lesson's T9); today's finished-lesson marker turns the fallback into `done`, so an outage after a lesson never offers a second one; offline (navigator.onLine false or the `offline` event) shows the designed offline card with Try again. Reversal: the plan read becomes part of the offline pack (packReady), so the fallback can show the true state offline

The Garden draws only the beds the child has started plus the class's current chapter (server `here`), never a bed per syllabus chapter: a class 3 garden would otherwise open on ~25 beds of bare seed packets, which is the banned 'empty-plot count' (§4.8). Not-started skills inside a drawn bed show as plots. Reversal: MW-M2 shows children cannot find where the next lesson grows without the empty beds

Sky map edges are the real topic prerequisites from data/curriculum/c<class>-<subject>.json (lazy 10-20 KB chunk on the map route), drawn only between two topics both on the visible map; a prerequisite in an earlier class draws nothing; cross-chapter edges are faint and dashed so the sky stays readable (class 6 maths: 24 same-class links). The map response carries no edges, and invented 'constellation lines' would be decoration posing as structure. Reversal: GET /api/child/map returns the prerequisite edges itself (then the client stops loading the syllabus files)

A pre-rendered clip (Hello greeting, onboarding Meet ▶) plays only under the face of the teacher who recorded it (src/child/voice.ts registry). Today only Asha's greeting exists (public/audio/hello-*.mp3), so Asha's Hello and Meet speak and Arjun's / Uma's show her words and face without sound. The old onboarding played Asha's 'Main Asha didi hoon' under every class, the audit #4 identity break in audio form. Reversal: per-teacher no-name greeting clips rendered in each live voice (then every Hello speaks)

Onboarding order (§3.2) built in B2: 1 class + board → 2 meet the class's actual teacher (GET /api/child/teacher?classLevel=) and pick her language once → 3 our promises + Hold to continue (the grown-up hold gate moved here from the account step; typed 'parent' alternative) → 4 account → 5 consent → 6 about the child (name, Casual / Respectful, the 12 interest pictures Hello shows, captions) → 7 PIN + limit → 9 hand over (Now → Hello, Later → the Parent corner). Every step opens at scrollY 0 with focus on its h1, the <title> follows the step, the primary action is in the flow (never sticky). /start/lang, /trust, /taste redirect. Step 8 (sound and mic check) is NOT built (B3). Reversal: V2-M8 shows the class-first order slows hand-over beyond 6 min

Generic CSS class names on child screens: `.avatar` (src/styles/app.css paints it a jamun disc) and `.pc` (src/styles/parent.css) collided, so every Older avatar sat in a navy ring and the home card would have taken parent-corner grid rules once the parent chunk had loaded. Found only in a screenshot (computed styles looked right on the button). Now `.cs-avatar` / `.hpc`; the battery's class list was grepped against every global stylesheet

Testing the offline home with the browser offline BEFORE the first load: there is no service worker / cached shell, so the SPA never loads and nothing can render (all 4 offline cases failed with an empty page). The offline home is tested by dropping the link after load (the home re-reads on the `offline` event). The cached-shell half of §6.1.1 'offline → the cached shell' does not exist yet

B2 battery tests/e2e-design-b2.mjs: 942/942 checks (n = 1 run, headless Chromium SwiftShader, the production build served by server/serve.mjs, every /api/* mocked with page.route; 360x640 DPR 2 touch + 1280x800; light + dark for Older): V-PLAN one primary card in all 9 home states incl. plan 404 / 500 / offline; V-LAYOUT-2, V-EN-1, V-NAME-1, V-SIG-2 (0 lamps), V-TGT over home, map, list, sheet, notebook, ask, me, your teacher, Hello cards 1-5 and onboarding 1-3; V-PERF-1 max 95 KB art per child route (bar 350 KB); tier D requested 0 backgrounds; V-ID-1 on home, map sheet, Hello, Your teacher, Meet; masters not served from the build; home text identical after 1 vs 30 days away; 5 negative controls trip. Not a device, child or parent measurement

For the lesson workstream (src/lesson/**, src/child/lesson/**): (1) LessonStartRequest.purpose is never sent: Practice and Ask after a done lesson are refused 409 by the plan gate (lt-start-gate); send purpose 'practice' / 'doubt' from the LessonScreen variant and show the 409 as the plan state; (2) /c/:cid/lesson/<lid> from 'Continue your lesson' starts a NEW lesson (no resume by lid); (3) prefs.face 'small' (Still picture) and 'voice' (Voice only) and prefs.largeText are set on Me but not honoured on the Desk

Not built in B2, listed so coverage is not implied: per-teacher greeting clips (Arjun, Uma Hello is silent); her once-a-day home greeting line (no endpoint); Young labels spoken on tap; Ask 'Say it' and 'Photo of the question' (no route; hidden, not dead buttons); the Garden/Sky sheet 'Hear {T}' line and Older 'How I know' evidence rows (no child evidence read); Notebook per-page explanation line and tray still, Older 'Notes for a friend'; Your teacher 10 s preview clips; protégé teach-back art and milestone ceremonies (lesson-side); Who avatars (src/app/Who.tsx, not this workstream); onboarding step 8 sound and mic check and field-level errors (B3); OCR no-text check (needs AZURE_VISION_*); the 18 rig stills (scripts/teacher-stills.mjs not run: every still renders the plate fallback); the human review sheet (B2-A2)

md.decisions:
## b2-art-pipeline
scripts/gen-assets.mjs (`--strict` is the B2-A2 acceptance run: every shipped id present, 0 pending, budgets, lint, provenance, OCR). Budgets [I]: backgrounds 120 KB at 1x, phone 60 KB, spots/states/tiles 40 KB, avatars/pictograms 16 KB; 2x provisional at 3x the 1x budget. 1x CSS widths per category are in `shipPlan` (bg wide 1280, phone 360, stage 480, sky-panel 800 + a 360x640 crop, picto 64, avatars 112, states 240, garden plants 112). Brand icons and the OG card pass through unchanged. Client: src/child/art.tsx (`<Scene id="home-young">` picks -phone / -wide with srcset 1x/2x and the LQIP; `<Spot id=… size=…>`), compatible with B1's src/ui/Art.tsx which reads the same manifest's `url`. Tier D (`?tier=D`, Save-Data, deviceMemory ≤ 1, prefers-reduced-data) loads no background. Known issue for the server owner: server/serve.mjs serves all of /assets/* as immutable for a year, which includes /assets/gen/manifest.json; a new deploy's manifest can be shadowed by a cached old one. Hashed image names are safe; the manifest needs no-cache (or a hashed name).

## b2-home-plan-fallback
src/child/plan.ts (`fromServer`, `fallbackPlan`, `usePlan`; unit-tested in tests/ui-v2-b2.test.mjs). The home exposes data-plan-state / data-plan-source.

## b2-garden-started-beds
src/child/progress/layout.ts `gardenBeds`.

## b2-sky-edges-syllabus
src/child/progress/prereqs.ts (`loadPrereqs`, `visibleEdges`); star hit targets are 48 px HTML buttons over the SVG (layout keeps ≥ 48 px between centres at 360).

## b2-clip-own-teacher-only
src/child/voice.ts `helloClip(teacherId, lang)`.

## b2-onboarding-order
src/onboarding/index.tsx, Layout.tsx (STEPS / ADD_STEPS, scroll + focus + title), steps/Class.tsx, steps/Meet.tsx, Consent.tsx (PromisesStep), Account.tsx (no hold gate), ChildProfile.tsx, Setup.tsx (PIN + handover). The consent rows' ▶ still read the server-held CONSENT_SPEECH text (server/routes/parent.js), which was written for the old gendered copy: the parent workstream should re-align it with the on-screen rows.

## b2-rejected-generic-class-names
Seen in the 360 Older home shot: a 4 px navy ring around the avatar disc. elementFromPoint at the ring returned the avatar span with background rgb(36,52,110) from app.css `.avatar`.

## b2-rejected-offline-before-load
`context.setOffline(true)` before `page.goto`: Chromium could not fetch the document; the 4 offline home cases rendered nothing.
